description.value: CorLan Vineyard & Farm is a 10-acre, 100% certified organic boutique winery and farm on Denman Island, producing award-winning wines under the 'To Ewe' label — including four gold medals at international competitions. Owners Pat and Selwyn Jones cleared the property in 2006, planted 5,000 vines from their own cuttings, and opened to the public in 2015; the estate now includes a tasting room, a restaurant, and farm stay accommodation. Cyclists can walk the vineyard and gardens, sample wines in the tasting room, and enjoy homemade lunches in a scenic south-facing forest setting.

address.value: 8441 McFarlane Rd, Denman Island, BC V0R 1T0
